com.github.pbednarcik.flexthemes FlexThemes Peter Bednarčík @VERSION@

Visual Studio-inspired light and dark themes for JetBrains IDEs, with calm colors, clear panel edges and easy-to-read code.

  • Light: Morning Mist, Lavender Mist (Gold, Indigo and Blue), Blue Mist, Periwinkle Islands
  • Dark: Graphite, Periwinkle Night, Abyss
  • A matching editor scheme for each, plus an alternative Lavender Mist Purple scheme
  • Shared code colors for C#, Java, Kotlin, Go and Python
  • Every text color checked for contrast
  • Tested in Rider, IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand and PyCharm 2026.2 with the Islands UI

Pick a theme under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance.

First release on JetBrains Marketplace: nine light and dark appearances and eight editor schemes for Rider, IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand and PyCharm with the Islands UI. Same themes as 0.7.0 on GitHub, with a clearer plugin description.
